items.title: Steve Buckingham, interviewed by Monk Rowe, Clinton, New York, February 25, 2019 [interview 1 of 2]
items.q: You know who Tom Scott is of course. ... Well he was the highest paid musician for a long time in LA. ... And Tom Scott did one in New York called the New York Connection with Pretty Purdie and all those guys.

ctx.x: They were paying you no matter what. If you were part of the Muscle Shoals Rhythm Section or you were freelancing. You would go to Muscle Shoals to work with those guys. Everybody went there. Dylan, all these people. But the union — you got paid no matter what. Now scale in the old days was not great — like when I started out — but it got better and better. And then I started paying, like a lot of people — I started as a player I was a double scale musician. Some of the guys, like Larry Carlton, when he was…
triple scale thinking it would cut back but they kept paying them and they were still working seven days making triple scale instead of double scale.
